summary: States that Ansible 2.5 and later support Python 3 (earlier was tech preview) and points to the control and managed node requirements for supported versions.
questions: Since which version does Ansible fully work on Python 3?

answer_card.title: Python 3 support
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible 2.5 and later work with Python 3; before 2.5 it was a tech preview. Check the Control Node and Managed Node Requirements for currently supported versions.
